'''June 2002 Nostalgia Booster Draft''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament in June 2002. [[Brian Matthews]] won it. It is known from Brian Matthews's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3732">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-06-12-the-card-board-box-being-placed-oopd3732/ the-card-board-box-being-placed-oop], DeckTech (brian "Sith_Pimp" matthews, 12 June 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-06-12-the-card-board-box-being-placed-oopd3732/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' June 2002
* '''Format:''' [[Reflections Booster Draft]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Brian Matthews]]
